task.name: Add a paginate helper
task.description: Add `paginate(items, page, pageSize)` in `src/paginate.mjs` as a named export. Pages are 1-based. It returns `{ items, page, totalPages }`. The last page may be shorter, and a page past the end returns an empty `items` array. A `page` or `pageSize` that is not an integer >= 1 throws a RangeError.

verificationCriteria.assertion: Invalid page or pageSize values are rejected with a RangeError
